title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
title_zh: TrainBridge：由GPU编译证据引导的智能体NPU训练优化

paragraphs.en: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7× speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0× across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations. 1 1 1 Our code is available at https://github.com/YChen-zzz/NPU_optimal_reference_skills .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究如何提升在昇腾 NPU 上的训练效率。 在我们所研究的 NPU 训练程序中，算子融合等框架级编译优化仅被部分应用，导致计算碎片化并留下可避免的执行开销。 基于性能剖析的调优可以解决这些低效问题，但往往需要代价高昂的反复试错。 为了让 NPU 上的训练更高效，我们提出 TrainBridge，一种将 GPU 优化指导迁移到 NPU 训练的智能体方法。 TrainBridge 利用由成熟 GPU 编译栈产出的高度优化的执行，作为面向特定任务的 NPU 调优参考。 它从 GPU 训练执行中提取优化意图，以指导 NPU 程序重写，并通过迭代式性能剖析进一步精炼重写后的程序。 我们的 GPU 到 NPU 迁移实验表明，TrainBridge 在涵盖 LLM 预训练、图像分类和多模态视觉-语言训练的四类工作负载上平均取得 1.7 倍加速，并且在 27 项采用高度优化 GPU 实现的 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun 记录上平均取得接近 2.0 倍的加速。1 1 1 我们的代码发布于 https://github.com/YChen-zzz/NPU_optimal_reference_skills 。

paragraphs.en: Efficient training on modern accelerators can benefit from framework-level compilation that optimizes computation across operators. Such compilation is mature on NVIDIA GPU backends. However , in the Ascend NPU training programs we study, these optimizations are partially applied by the available compilation stack ( Yu, 2026 ) . As a result, the execution of the training algorithm involves fragmented computation, redundant operations, and materialized intermediates, leaving space for NPU-specific program tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在现代加速器上进行高效训练可以受益于框架级编译，它能跨算子地优化计算。 这种编译在 NVIDIA GPU 后端上已经相当成熟。 然而，在我们所研究的昇腾（Ascend）NPU 训练程序中，现有的编译栈（Yu, 2026）仅部分应用了这些优化。 因此，训练算法的执行涉及碎片化的计算、冗余的操作以及被物化的中间结果，这为面向 NPU 的程序调优留下了空间。

sents.zh: 在现代加速器上进行高效训练可以受益于框架级编译，它能跨算子地优化计算。

sents.en: Such compilation is mature on NVIDIA GPU backends.
sents.zh: 这种编译在 NVIDIA GPU 后端上已经相当成熟。

sents.en: However , in the Ascend NPU training programs we study, these optimizations are partially applied by the available compilation stack ( Yu, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 然而，在我们所研究的昇腾（Ascend）NPU 训练程序中，现有的编译栈（Yu, 2026）仅部分应用了这些优化。

sents.zh: 因此，训练算法的执行涉及碎片化的计算、冗余的操作以及被物化的中间结果，这为面向 NPU 的程序调优留下了空间。

paragraphs.en: Such NPU-specific tuning is often manual and expert-driven. Providing a tuning agent with task-specific knowledge, such as NPU profiling results ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , enables it to diagnose bottlenecks and improve the NPU program. However, even with profiling guidance, the agent still needs to iteratively analyze, modify, execute, and validate the program , making the optimization process time-consuming under a limited tuning budget. This motivates us to seek additional guidance that can make the tuning process more efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 这类针对 NPU 的专项调优通常是手动的、依赖专家经验的。 为调优智能体提供任务相关的知识，例如 NPU 性能分析结果（Zhang et al., 2025c；Li et al., 2026a；Zhou et al., 2025），能够使其诊断瓶颈并改进 NPU 程序。 然而，即使有性能分析的指导，该智能体仍需要迭代地分析、修改、执行和验证程序，使得在有限的调优预算下优化过程非常耗时。 这促使我们寻求额外的指导，以使调优过程更加高效。

paragraphs.en: To provide this additional guidance, we introduce TrainBridge, a two-stage agentic framework for NPU-specific optimization. We observe that the corresponding GPU training programs already benefit from substantial optimization by mature compilation stacks. The differences between the eager and compiled GPU execution reveal optimization decisions already made for the same workload. Therefore, we think the differences are useful guidance on NPU execution. In Stage 1, TrainBridge extracts the underlying optimization intents from the differences and constructs NPU-specific rewrites when corresponding inefficient computation patterns are present in the NPU program. In Stage 2, it iteratively profiles the updated program to identify remaining bottlenecks, addresses them, and updates the profile.
paragraphs.zh: 为了提供这种额外的指导，我们提出了 TrainBridge，一个面向 NPU 专用优化的两阶段智能体框架。 我们观察到，对应的 GPU 训练程序已经通过成熟的编译栈获得了大量的优化。 eager 执行与编译执行的 GPU 运行之间的差异，揭示了针对同一负载已经做出的优化决策。 因此，我们认为这些差异对 NPU 执行是有用的指导。 在第一阶段，TrainBridge 从这些差异中提取底层的优化意图，并在 NPU 程序中存在对应的低效计算模式时构建 NPU 专用的改写。 在第二阶段，它对更新后的程序进行迭代式剖析，以识别剩余的瓶颈、加以解决，并更新剖析结果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate TrainBridge in a GPU-to-NPU migration setting on training workloads spanning LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖大语言模型预训练、图像分类和视觉-语言训练的训练工作负载上，于 GPU 到 NPU 的迁移场景中评估 TrainBridge。

paragraphs.en: In addition, we introduce an NPU version of the Modded-NanoGPT speedrun ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) , a highly optimized community benchmark for end-to-end language-model pretraining efficiency under a fixed validation target. We adapt its historical GPU implementations to Ascend NPUs and release an open leaderboard 2 2 2 https://github.com/zhaoyiyidan/modded-nanogpt-npu and evaluation environment to support further NPU training optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们推出了 Modded-NanoGPT 速跑（speedrun）（Jordan et al., 2024）的 NPU 版本，这是一个高度优化的社区基准，用于在固定验证目标下衡量端到端语言模型预训练的效率。 我们将其历史上的 GPU 实现适配到昇腾（Ascend）NPU 上，并发布开放的排行榜（https://github.com/zhaoyiyidan/modded-nanogpt-npu）和评估环境，以支持进一步的 NPU 训练优化。

paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We identify compilation-related optimization gaps in NPU training programs. To narrow these gaps, we present TrainBridge, a two-stage agentic approach. TrainBridge first extracts optimization intents from the differences between eager and compiled GPU implementations and uses them to guide NPU program rewrites, then iteratively profiles the rewritten program to address residual bottlenecks.

On the four additional workloads, it reduces the average NPU-to-GPU training-time ratio from 2.8× to 1.5×.

paragraphs.en: Modded-NanoGPT builds on NanoGPT 6 6 6 https://github.com/KellerJordan/Modded-NanoGPT , a language-model pretraining codebase widely used for studying the architectural properties of LLMs ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and training algorithms ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . The original GPU speedrun requires participants to train a language model on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs and achieve a validation loss below 3.28 ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) . The speedrun contains the GPT-2 small, GPT-2 Medium, and optimization tracks. We study the GPT-2 small track, which contains a sequence of high-performance implementations developed over time. These implementations use different training and kernel optimizations and therefore provide diverse migration tasks. We use record to denote a valid historical leaderboard implementation that reaches the required loss target; a larger record number indicates a later and faster implementation with a shorter end-to-end training time.
paragraphs.zh: Modded-NanoGPT 基于 NanoGPT 6 6 6 https://github.com/KellerJordan/Modded-NanoGPT 构建，这是一个被广泛用于研究大语言模型架构特性（Zhang 等，2024）和训练算法（Yuan 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025b；Zhang 等，2025a）的语言模型预训练代码库。 原始的 GPU 速通要求参与者在八块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上训练一个语言模型，并达到低于 3.28 的验证损失（Jordan 等，2024）。 该速通包含 GPT-2 small、GPT-2 Medium 和优化三个赛道。 我们研究 GPT-2 small 赛道，其中包含一系列随时间不断开发的高性能实现。 这些实现采用了不同的训练和内核优化，因此提供了多样化的迁移任务。 我们用 record 表示一个达到所需损失目标的有效历史排行榜实现；record 编号越大表示该实现越新、越快，且端到端训练时间越短。

paragraphs.en: Across the four additional workloads besides Modded-NanoGPT, the initial NPU-to-GPU end-to-end training-time ratio averages 2.8 × \times . For Record 50, the compiled GPU implementation takes 128 seconds and the initial NPU implementation takes 563 seconds, giving a ratio of 4.40 × \times . These measurements reflect differences in both hardware capability and software optimization. Reported compute-throughput figures 8 8 8 https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/h100/ ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) suggest that the Ascend 910C provides roughly 76% of the H100 SXM’s peak dense BF16/FP16 compute throughput. paragraphs.en: NPU profiling provides useful task-specific guidance by identifying expensive operators and timeline intervals. However, high runtime alone does not indicate how much a region can be accelerated or which optimization should be applied. The agent therefore needs repeated cycles of analysis, modification, execution, and validation to discover effective changes. While this process can improve performance, it can be time-consuming and inefficient under a limited tuning budget. This motivates complementary guidance that can narrow the optimization search space.
paragraphs.zh: NPU 剖析通过识别开销较大的算子和时间线区间，提供了有用的任务特定指导。 然而，仅凭较高的运行时间并不能表明某个区域可以被加速多少，或者应该应用哪种优化。 因此，智能体需要反复进行分析、修改、执行和验证的循环，才能发现有效的改动。 虽然这一过程可以提升性能，但在有限的调优预算下可能耗时且低效。 这促使我们需要能够缩小优化搜索空间的补充性指导。

paragraphs.en: GPU training ecosystems combine expert-designed implementations with mature framework-level compilation. For the same workload, differences between eager and compiled GPU execution reveal concrete changes that eliminate, fuse, or reorganize computation. Modded-NanoGPT Record 50 provides a representative example. Table 1 shows that, on eight NVIDIA H100 SXM GPUs, framework-level compilation through torch.compile reduces the end-to-end training time of Record 50 from around 338 seconds to 128 seconds, demonstrating its contribution to training efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Modded-NanoGPT Record 50 provides one example. Its KeyShift operation shifts half of each attention head’s key features by one token along the sequence dimension. The original overlapping-slice assignment remains and produces a sequence of ViewCopy operations. Consistent with prior reports of compilation limitations on Ascend ( Yu, 2026 ) , the Ascend NPU compilation stack did not successfully produce a runnable end-to-end compiled program in our migrated training setting, leaving this inefficiency in the executed NPU implementation. The same inefficiency is present in eager GPU execution, whereas the compiled GPU execution eliminates it through functionalization and kernel fusion. Then, the agent extracts the intent of avoiding overlapping view updates and proposes an NPU-specific expression that realizes this intent. Table 2 reports the performance improvement from the NPU-specific rewrite.
paragraphs.zh: Modded-NanoGPT 记录 50 提供了一个示例。 其 KeyShift 操作沿序列维度将每个注意力头的键特征的一半移动一个 token。 原始的重叠切片赋值仍然存在，并产生一系列 ViewCopy 操作。 与先前关于 Ascend 编译局限性的报告（Yu, 2026）一致，在我们的迁移训练设置中，Ascend NPU 编译栈未能成功生成可运行的端到端编译程序，从而在执行的 NPU 实现中留下了这一低效问题。 同样的低效问题也存在于 eager GPU 执行中，而编译后的 GPU 执行通过函数化与算子融合消除了它。 随后，智能体提取出避免重叠视图更新的意图，并提出了一种实现该意图的 NPU 专用表达方式。 表 2 报告了 NPU 专用重写带来的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: We first formalize how source-side framework-level compilation provides optimization evidence for NPU tuning. In our source GPU setting, this compilation is implemented through PyTorch torch.compile . Such compilation may transform computation graphs and execution schedules, introduce fused regions, modify compiler IR, and generate specialized kernels. For clarity, we use computation-graph changes as a representative view to formulate the optimization problem; TrainBridge itself is not restricted to graph-level transformations. Our goal is to improve the end-to-end training time of the migrated NPU program while preserving its correctness requirements under a limited tuning budget.

paragraphs.zh: 在这种情况下，智能体可以利用 eager 模式与编译后的 GPU 之间的差异来推断底层优化意图，并推导出 NPU 专用的改写，在保持原始计算语义的同时消除或减少相应的低效问题。 将此类改写应用于所有适用的区域，可以提升迁移后的 NPU 程序的训练效率。

paragraphs.en: However, GPU evidence cannot address all inefficiencies in the migrated NPU program. Some GPU transformations may not be beneficial on the NPU because of backend-specific execution characteristics, and GPU evidence does not expose NPU-specific overheads in host scheduling, communication, or memory management. These limitations motivate the two stages below.

paragraphs.en: For the same training program, we collect GPU compilation artifacts, including pre-compilation graphs, post-fusion IR, generated kernels, and profiling summaries, together with the corresponding GPU and migrated NPU sources. Based on this evidence, TrainBridge groups related GPU operations into semantic supernodes. A semantic supernode represents a common high-level computation and provides a unit for relating source-side compilation changes to the migrated NPU program.
paragraphs.zh: 针对同一个训练程序，我们收集 GPU 编译产物，包括编译前计算图、融合后的中间表示（IR）、生成的内核以及性能分析摘要，并连同相应的 GPU 源代码和迁移后的 NPU 源代码一起保存。 基于这些证据，TrainBridge 将相关的 GPU 算子聚合为语义超节点。 语义超节点代表一个共同的高层计算，并作为一个单元，用于将源侧编译中的变更关联到迁移后的 NPU 程序。

sents.en: For the same training program, we collect GPU compilation artifacts, including pre-compilation graphs, post-fusion IR, generated kernels, and profiling summaries, together with the corresponding GPU and migrated NPU sources.
sents.zh: 针对同一个训练程序，我们收集 GPU 编译产物，包括编译前计算图、融合后的中间表示（IR）、生成的内核以及性能分析摘要，并连同相应的 GPU 源代码和迁移后的 NPU 源代码一起保存。

sents.en: Based on this evidence, TrainBridge groups related GPU operations into semantic supernodes.
sents.zh: 基于这些证据，TrainBridge 将相关的 GPU 算子聚合为语义超节点。

sents.en: A semantic supernode represents a common high-level computation and provides a unit for relating source-side compilation changes to the migrated NPU program.
sents.zh: 语义超节点代表一个共同的高层计算，并作为一个单元，用于将源侧编译中的变更关联到迁移后的 NPU 程序。

paragraphs.en: For each supernode, the agent first examines the eager-to-compiled GPU changes to identify what computation was eliminated, fused, or reorganized. These changes provide evidence of an inefficient computation pattern in the eager execution and the optimization intent used to address it. The agent then locates the NPU region implementing the same high-level computation and checks whether the corresponding inefficiency remains, using differences in operators, dtypes, layouts, materialized intermediates, and kernel boundaries as evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个超节点，智能体首先检查即时执行到编译后的 GPU 变更，以识别哪些计算被消除、融合或重组。 这些变更提供了即时执行中低效计算模式的证据，以及用于解决该问题的优化意图。 然后，智能体定位实现相同高层计算的 NPU 区域，并检查相应的低效问题是否仍然存在，将算子、数据类型、布局、物化的中间结果以及算子核边界上的差异作为证据。

sents.en: For each supernode, the agent first examines the eager-to-compiled GPU changes to identify what computation was eliminated, fused, or reorganized.
sents.zh: 对于每个超节点，智能体首先检查即时执行到编译后的 GPU 变更，以识别哪些计算被消除、融合或重组。

sents.en: These changes provide evidence of an inefficient computation pattern in the eager execution and the optimization intent used to address it.
sents.zh: 这些变更提供了即时执行中低效计算模式的证据，以及用于解决该问题的优化意图。

sents.en: The agent then locates the NPU region implementing the same high-level computation and checks whether the corresponding inefficiency remains, using differences in operators, dtypes, layouts, materialized intermediates, and kernel boundaries as evidence.
sents.zh: 然后，智能体定位实现相同高层计算的 NPU 区域，并检查相应的低效问题是否仍然存在，将算子、数据类型、布局、物化的中间结果以及算子核边界上的差异作为证据。

paragraphs.en: When the inefficiency remains on the NPU, the agent uses the inferred optimization intent to propose an NPU-specific rewrite that removes or reduces it while preserving the original computation semantics. Candidate rewrites include API parameter changes, redundant-operation removal, fused NPU operators, and selective compilation of supported local subgraphs. Stage 1 ends after all semantic supernodes have been examined and applicable GPU-evidence-guided rewrites have been validated.
paragraphs.zh: 当低效问题仍存在于 NPU 上时，智能体利用推断出的优化意图提出一种针对 NPU 的重写方案，在保持原有计算语义的前提下消除或减少该低效。 候选重写方案包括 API 参数修改、冗余操作移除、融合的 NPU 算子，以及对受支持的本地子图进行选择性编译。 在所有语义超节点均被检查且适用的 GPU 证据引导的重写均已验证之后，阶段 1 结束。

sents.en: Candidate rewrites include API parameter changes, redundant-operation removal, fused NPU operators, and selective compilation of supported local subgraphs.

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 profiles the NPU program produced by Stage 1 to identify residual bottlenecks that are not captured by source-side GPU compilation evidence. The agent combines operator statistics, host and device timelines, communication events, memory activity, and source inspection to identify the remaining bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2 对阶段 1 生成的 NPU 程序进行性能剖析，以识别源侧 GPU 编译证据未能捕获的残余瓶颈。 智能体结合算子统计信息、主机与设备时间线、通信事件、内存活动以及源码检查来识别剩余瓶颈。

sents.en: The agent combines operator statistics, host and device timelines, communication events, memory activity, and source inspection to identify the remaining bottlenecks.

paragraphs.en: The agent considers several common optimization classes: eliminating redundant work, reusing computed values or buffers, hiding latency through overlap, and replacing an implementation with an equivalent NPU-native alternative. After each candidate modification, TrainBridge revalidates correctness and performance and updates the profile when the bottleneck shifts. The agent repeats this process until no further performance improvement is observed or the tuning budget is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体会考虑几种常见的优化类别：消除冗余工作、重用已计算的值或缓冲区、通过重叠来隐藏延迟，以及用等效的 NPU 原生替代方案替换现有实现。 每次应用候选修改后，TrainBridge 都会重新验证正确性和性能，并在瓶颈发生变化时更新性能画像。 智能体会重复此过程，直到不再观察到性能提升或调优预算耗尽为止。

paragraphs.en: As described in Section 2.1 , our evaluation covers five training workloads: CIFAR-10 AirBench 9 9 9 https://github.com/KellerJordan/cifar10-airbench , Qwen3-0.6B pretraining with Hugging Face Trainer, ViT training with TIMM 10 10 10 https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models , nanoVLM 11 11 11 https://github.com/huggingface/nanoVLM , and Modded-NanoGPT. We migrate each workload to Ascend 910C NPUs and tune the migrated NPU implementation. For Modded-NanoGPT, we randomly sample and evaluate 27 historical records from the first 50 leaderboard records, treating each record as a separate tuning task. A valid optimization must preserve the original training schedule and reach a validation loss below 3.28 at the same training step. The correctness criteria for the other workloads are described in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 如第 2.1 节所述，我们的评估涵盖五个训练工作负载：CIFAR-10 AirBench 9 9 9 https://github.com/KellerJordan/cifar10-airbench 、使用 Hugging Face Trainer 的 Qwen3-0.6B 预训练、使用 TIMM 10 10 10 https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models 的 ViT 训练、nanoVLM 11 11 11 https://github.com/huggingface/nanoVLM ，以及 Modded-NanoGPT。 我们将每个工作负载迁移至昇腾 910C NPU，并对迁移后的 NPU 实现进行调优。 对于 Modded-NanoGPT，我们从前 50 条排行榜记录中随机抽取 27 条历史记录并进行评估，将每条记录视为一个独立的调优任务。 有效的优化必须保持原有训练计划不变，并在相同的训练步数下达到低于 3.28 的验证损失。 其余工作负载的正确性标准见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ2, we compare TrainBridge with an agent that already has task-specific knowledge from NPU profiling but does not use GPU compilation evidence. In contrast, Stage 2 alone reaches around 334 seconds and does not fall below 300 seconds within the budget. These results show that GPU compilation evidence provides substantial additional guidance beyond profiling alone, while the further improvement after Stage 1 shows that target-side profiling remains complementary.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents have been used to generate and optimize GPU kernels through execution feedback, hardware profiling, iterative search, and reusable optimization experience ( Dai et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Dong et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . KernelBench provides a common benchmark for kernel correctness and speed ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) . Recent work extends agentic optimization to NPU kernel synthesis and broader ML systems, including end-to-end LLM deployment on AMD NPUs ( Li et al., 2026b ) , Ascend C kernel optimization in large-scale training ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and GPU training-engine construction ( He et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 通过执行反馈、硬件性能分析、迭代搜索以及可复用的优化经验，LLM 智能体已被用于生成和优化 GPU 核函数（Dai et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2025c；Dong et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026）。 KernelBench 为核函数的正确性和速度提供了通用基准（Ouyang et al., 2025）。 近期工作将智能体优化扩展到 NPU 核函数合成和更广泛的机器学习系统，包括在 AMD NPU 上的端到端 LLM 部署（Li et al., 2026b）、大规模训练中昇腾 C 核函数的优化（Li et al., 2026a），以及 GPU 训练引擎的构建（He et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: At each iteration, an optimization agent must decide where to intervene and which change to try. Existing methods improve these decisions in two ways. Training-based methods improve the underlying LLM through task-specific training ; CUDA Agent uses large-scale agentic reinforcement learning with execution-based rewards to learn CUDA optimization behavior ( Dai et al., 2026 ) . Training-free methods instead augment inference-time guidance: CUDAForge uses hardware profiles to diagnose bottlenecks ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) , STARK organizes prior candidates in a search tree to guide planning ( Dong et al., 2026 ) , and KernelSkill retrieves reusable expert knowledge while tracking the current optimization trajectory ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . EvoKernel similarly retrieves value-weighted experience for NPU kernel synthesis ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在每次迭代中，优化智能体必须决定在何处干预以及尝试哪种改动。 现有方法从两个方面改进这些决策。 基于训练的方法通过任务特定训练改进底层大语言模型；CUDA Agent 使用大规模智能体强化学习并结合基于执行的奖励来学习 CUDA 优化行为（Dai et al., 2026）。 免训练方法则增强推理时的引导：CUDAForge 使用硬件配置文件来诊断瓶颈（Zhang et al., 2025c），STARK 在搜索树中组织先前候选方案以引导规划（Dong et al., 2026），KernelSkill 在跟踪当前优化轨迹的同时检索可复用的专家知识（Sun et al., 2026）。 EvoKernel 类似地为 NPU 核函数合成检索价值加权的经验（Zheng et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: TrainBridge requires a source GPU implementation from which useful framework-level compilation evidence can be obtained. This requirement provides task-specific optimization guidance but limits the method to workloads supported by a mature source stack. A natural extension is to store source-side optimization evidence produced by the GPU compilation stack, together with validated NPU implementations, in a retrieval database. Such a database could provide reusable knowledge about source-side optimization intents and their successful NPU implementations , helping agents prioritize promising rewrites for new workloads.
paragraphs.zh: TrainBridge 需要一个源 GPU 实现，从中可以获取有用的框架级编译证据。 这一要求提供了任务特定的优化指导，但也限制了该方法只能用于已有成熟源技术栈支持的负载。 一个自然的扩展是将 GPU 编译技术栈产生的源侧优化证据，连同经过验证的 NPU 实现，一并存入检索数据库。 这样的数据库可以提供关于源侧优化意图及其成功 NPU 实现的可复用知识，帮助智能体为新负载优先选择有前景的重写方案。

paragraphs.en: We study compilation-related optimization inefficiencies in NPU training and investigate how evidence from mature GPU compilation stacks can guide NPU-specific program optimization. TrainBridge extracts optimization intents from differences between eager and compiled GPU implementations, constructs NPU-specific rewrites, and profiles the updated program to address residual bottlenecks. It achieves a 2.0 × 2.0\times NPU speedup across Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records and a 1.7 × 1.7\times speedup across four additional workloads. These results show that GPU compilation evidence can guide NPU-specific program optimization and help address compilation-related inefficiencies in NPU training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究NPU训练中与编译相关的优化低效问题，并探究来自成熟GPU编译体系的经验如何指导面向NPU的程序优化。 TrainBridge从GPU的即时执行实现与编译实现之间的差异中提取优化意图，构建面向NPU的改写，并对更新后的程序进行性能剖析以解决剩余瓶颈。 它在Modded-NanoGPT竞速记录上实现了2.0 × 2.0\times的NPU加速，并在另外四个工作负载上实现了1.7 × 1.7\times的加速。 这些结果表明，GPU编译经验可以指导面向NPU的程序优化，并有助于解决NPU训练中与编译相关的低效问题。

paragraphs.en: Due to time and computational-resource constraints, we limit this experiment to an 8-hour tuning budget and perform a single run for each method. The result can be seen in Figure 6 . Within the 8-hour budget, Claude Opus 4.8 with TrainBridge finds a faster validated NPU implementation than Claude Opus 4.8 alone. This result is consistent with the main experiment in Section 4.4 and suggests that GPU-compilation evidence can provide useful optimization guidance beyond the agent model used in our primary evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 由于时间和计算资源的限制，我们将此实验限定为 8 小时的调优预算，并对每种方法仅进行单次运行。 结果见图 6。 在 8 小时预算内，使用 TrainBridge 的 Claude Opus 4.8 比单独使用 Claude Opus 4.8 找到了更快的经验证的 NPU 实现。 该结果与 4.4 节的主实验一致，并表明 GPU 编译证据可以为我们主要评估中使用的智能体模型之外的其他智能体模型提供有用的优化指导。
